description: Search the open roles of Sara's List at growth-stage companies. Returns a page of roles and a nextCursor to read the following page. Credit the data to Sara's List (https://thesaraslist.com); a new role stays Pro-only for its first 24 hours, so a free key and a call with no key read it only after that window.

company.description: The slug of one employer, for example "acme".

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous answer. Leave it out for the first page.

equityOnly.description: True reads only roles that state stock options.

limit.description: The page size, from 1 to 50. The default is 20.

location.description: The name of a city or a country, for example "Berlin".

minSalaryUsd.description: The lowest salary the role must state, in USD.

query.description: Free text over the role title. Leave it out to read every role.

role.description: The role slug of the board, for example "backend-engineer".

workplace.description: Where the role sits: Remote, Hybrid or OnSite.

name: search_jobs
title: Search open roles
